newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Virgin Express may seek bourse listing - paper.
newsitem.headline: Virgin Express may seek bourse listing - paper.

text.p: Richard Branson's Virgin Express no-frills airline may be seeking a bourse listing, leading Belgian financial newspaper L'Echo said on Friday.
"Profiting from the favourable bourse climate...it seems that Virgin Express is currently preparing a bourse entry," L'Echo said. It said a company audit was being carried out.
It added however that it was not clear whether Virgin Express was seeking a listing in Brussels or on Easdaq, Europe's fledgling growth stocks market.
Virgin Express chief executive Jonathan Ornstein was not available for comment.
Brussels-based Virgin Express flies to some 150 charter destinations and operates scheduled daily services between 10 major European cities.
It was launched last April after Branson's Virgin Group bought control of EuroBelgian Airlines (EBA) from Belgian, bourse-listed hotels group City Hotels.
